behaviors.description: Resolve contrasting download/delete policies from declared extensions.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent policy repository; empty installation; Automatic declares no-autodownload=false/autodelete=false and Optional declares both true.
behaviors.expected: Exactly both extension identities and fixture commits; should_download/should_delete are true/false for Automatic and false/true for Optional; fetched main metadata matches independent exported declarations.

behaviors.preconditions: Controlled HTTP repository, first absent cache then populated A cache with server advertising B.
behaviors.expected: Absent cache returns NOT_CACHED; populated cache yields exact A identity/membership; neither query phase performs any HTTP request.

behaviors.description: Distinguish available and locally installed related refs.
behaviors.preconditions: App declares optional extension; extension initially absent, then installed from another remote.
behaviors.expected: Remote list has exact extension and commit; installed list starts empty then includes extension installed from other remote; policy and full-subpath values asserted.

behaviors.description: Resolve related branches against the installed app version.
behaviors.preconditions: Installed A requests test extension; remote B requests next extension.
behaviors.expected: Remote query returns next; for-installed query returns test, each with controlled commit and policy values.

behaviors.description: List available refs by remote name and URI.
behaviors.preconditions: No refs installed; prepared multi-ref repository.
behaviors.expected: Both sources return the exact advertised native-architecture ref set.

behaviors.description: Include a foreign-architecture ref in remote enumeration.
behaviors.preconditions: Prepared repository includes an app for an architecture outside host primary architectures.
behaviors.expected: ALL_ARCHES returns exact complete advertised set including the foreign app.

behaviors.description: Compare remote cached and direct metadata and sizes.
behaviors.preconditions: Expected bytes and integer sizes from independently exported commit metadata.
behaviors.expected: Cached getters and direct queries match every expected value.

behaviors.description: Query remote B while A remains deployed.
behaviors.preconditions: Installed A; same remote changed to independent B repository.
behaviors.expected: Remote ref commit B and origin queries; installed lookup still returns A.

behaviors.description: Assert the public AppStream refresh callback contract.
behaviors.preconditions: Uncached AppStream over deliberately delayed HTTP payloads; a distinct pushed thread-default context and live user-data sentinel.
behaviors.expected: At least one callback uses exact supplied data on the caller thread while owning its selected context, with displayable status and bounded percentage. Estimating and final progress are recorded without prescribing values. No callbacks occur in the post-return observation window or during a later callback-free refresh; refreshed XML matches reference export.
notes: GLib permits direct invocation while the selected context is owned even with a different thread-default context pushed. Because pushing acquires ownership, this verifies execution conditions, not a particular dispatch mechanism.

behaviors.description: Refresh a remote's AppStream cache and inspect its public location.
behaviors.preconditions: Prepared repository contains independently exported native AppStream XML; cache initially absent.
behaviors.expected: First refresh changes content; repeat does not; remote AppStream directory contains XML equivalent to the prepared repository snapshot.

mappings.rationale: Real reference-exported extension declarations produce opposite download/delete results on public related-ref enumeration; exact membership, commits, absent installed state and fetched declaration bytes are asserted without fabricated result properties.
Both full APIs assert exact NOT_CACHED errors without HTTP on fresh cache and exact stale A results without HTTP after priming.
Actual declared extension and empty-before/one-after installed lists include extension deployed from another remote.
Divergent app metadata produces exact next remote result and test for-installed result with fixture commits.
Both configured name and URI yield exact native app/runtime ref membership while none is installed.
Exact complete ALL_ARCHES membership includes independently exported foreign architecture.
Cached and direct byte results and both size integers match values recorded during independent preparation.
Remote identity/origin/B commit checked alongside still-deployed distinct A commit.

C assertions require a callback and check exact user data, active call scope, caller thread, ownership of the originally selected context, display status and percentage range. Estimating accepts gboolean zero/nonzero semantics and is recorded, as are final progress values. Post-return context iteration and a subsequent callback-free refresh check bounded call scope. Delayed payload observation and independent XML verify real refresh work. Context ownership is an execution condition, not proof of main-loop dispatch; nested thread-default contexts are permitted.
TRUE first refresh and FALSE unchanged repeat; compressed XML at public remote cache directory compared against independent reference-exported AppStream.
